characteristics.name: Special Rules

characteristics.name: Income
characteristics.$text: 3d6x5

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text:
**Martial Training**: In step 3 of the Aftermath sequence you can pick up to 3 friendly *Knight* fighters to take part in martial training. Each of those fighters earns d6 bonus experience.
**Search the City**: In step 5 of the aftermath sequence, if you won the battle, you gain 1 additional re-roll when searching the City.

characteristics.name: Income
characteristics.$text: 3d6x5

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text:
**Blasphemous Study**: In each Aftermath sequence, you can pick 1 of the following:
- *Scry Ancient Scrolls*: Roll a dice for each *Wizard* in your warband. Record an ongoing tally on your Warband Roster. Each time the tally exceeds a multiple of 20, you can pick a *Wizard* in your warband to earn enough experience to receive their next advancement.
- *Brew Concoctions*: Roll a dice for each *Wizard* in your warband. For each roll of 5+, you can add 1 Vial of Poison item to your stash.

characteristics.name: Income
characteristics.$text: 3d6x5

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text:
**Venerate Living Saints**: Each time a Dreg Cultist in this warband earns a level of Black Rot, they earn 5 additional experience.
**Canonise the Fallen**: Each time a fighter in this warband is killed, every Dreg Cultist in this warband earns 10 additional bonus experience in step 3 of the aftermath sequence.

characteristics.name: Income
characteristics.$text: 3d6x5

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text:
**Demonic Communion**: Before the Aftermath sequence, roll on the table below. If you won the battle, roll 3d6. If you lost, roll 2d6:
|2d6|Effect|
|---|:--|
|2|**Damnation**: Your leader is killed. You can add a Demonic
Rotspawn to your warband without paying any silver. It bears the name of your former leader.|
|3-8|**Silence**: No effect.|
|9-12|**Minor Boon**: Your leader earns 10 bonus experience.|
|13-15|**Demonic Ally**: You can add a Rot Demon or a Rotling to your warband without paying any silver.|
|16+|**Major Boon**: Your leader earns 30 bonus experience.|

rules.name: Master of Dark Spellcraft
rules.description: This fighter knows the Lore of Blessed Maggots. When they are recruited, pick 2 spells from it to be their signature spells. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

rules.name: Darkcloven Magic
rules.description: This fighter knows the **Lore of Blessed Maggots** and the **Demonic Lore of Rot**. However, when they are recruited they have no signature spells. At the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from each lore.

sharedRules.name: Ram Horns
sharedRules.description:
After this fighter finishes a Charge Move, pick 1 enemy fighter engaged in melee with them to be the target. The target is hit by 2 attacks as follows:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|1|

sharedRules.name: Fear
sharedRules.description:
This fighter *causes fear*. Enemy fighters that start their activation engaged in melee with a fighter that causes fear must pass a Willpower test. If they
fail, their activation immediately ends.
Enemy fighters that also cause fear can ignore this rule.

sharedRules.name: Demonic Wards
sharedRules.description: This fighter ignores Rend when making armour rolls.

While this fighter is on the battlefield, you can re-roll flee tests.
You can re-roll Willpower tests made by friendly fighters while they are within 12" of this fighter and this fighter is visible to them.

rules.name: Demonic Familiar
rules.description:
Each time this fighter makes a melee attack, they can make 1 additional attack with the following weapon:
|Rend|Damage|Critical Damage|Weapon Traits|
|---|---|---|:--|
|-|1|d3|Arcane, Natural Weapon, Poison|

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 9" of the caster to be the target. That fighter is *swollen* until the end of the round. While a fighter is *swollen*, they can ignore the first 3 points of damage they suffer.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a visible point on the battlefield floor within 6" of the caster. Until the end of the round, the battlefield floor within 6" of that point is a *mire*. Subtract 2 from the maximum distance a non-*Cloister* fighter can move each time they move across the mire.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: The battlefield floor within 9" of that point is a *mire*, instead of 6".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: The closest visible enemy fighter within 9" is targeted and suffers d3 damage. If they are not taken down, they must pass a Willpower test, else scatter d6".

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a point within 12" of the caster, it then scatters d6".
Each fighter in the template is targeted and heals d3 life.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: It does not scatter.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a friendly fighter within 6" of the casting fighter to be the target,. That fighter has a *putrid blessing* until the end of the round. While a fighter has a *putrid blessing*, their Melee Weapons gain the *Arcane* and *Poison* weapon traits.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the flame template from the caster. Each fighter in the template is targeted and hit with the following attack:
|Rend|Damage|
|---|---|
|-1|d3|

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Each fighter hit by the attack must pass a Willpower test else they become poisoned, (see the *Poison* weapon trait).

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
A *summoned* Rotling fighter, is added to the caster's warband until it is taken down. Set up the fighter within 3" of the caster and not engaged in melee.
A warband cannot have more than 3 *summoned* fighters at any time. If the caster's warband already has 3 *summoned* fighters, they cannot cast this spell.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: The fighter can be set up within 9" of the caster and not engaged in melee.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a friendly *Demon* or *Beastman* fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target. That fighter has *demonic strength* until the end of the round. While a fighter has *demonic strength*, add 1 to the Damage and Critical Damage values of their Melee Weapons.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: You can pick 2 fighters to be targets instead of 1.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: The closest visible enemy fighter within 9" is targeted and suffers 1 damage. If they are not taken down, they have *rotten insides*. While a fighter has *rotten insides* their Move value is 2". At the end of a fighter with *rotten insides*' activation they take a Willpower test. If they pass, they no longer have rotten insides.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Place the blast template centred on a point within 15" of the caster. Each enemy fighter in the template is targeted and must pass a Willpower test else they become *poisoned*, (see the *Poison* weapon trait).

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Subtract 1 from any Willpower tests made for this spell.

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text: Pick a friendly *Demon* or *Beastman* fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target. That fighter has a *protective shroud* until the end of the round. While a fighter has *protective shroud*, improve their Armour value by 1.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range to 12".

characteristics.name: Normal Effect
characteristics.$text:
Place the blast template centred on a visible point on the battlefield floor within 9" of the caster. A pit opens here. In an order chosen by the commanding player of the caster, each fighter in the template is removed from the battlefield and set up again at the edge of the pit by its commanding player, not engaged in melee. If there is no space, they are set up as close to the edge of the pit as possible, not engaged in melee.
After being set up, the fighter must pass an Initiative test else suffer d3 damage and become *poisoned* (see the *Poison* weapon trait).
The pit remains in play until the end of the round. Fighters cannot move across the pit while they are on the battlefield floor. Any treasure tokens on the pit are destroyed.

characteristics.name: Critical Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the range from 9" to 12".

rules.name: Demonic Spellcraft
rules.description:
This fighter knows the **Demonic Lore of Rot**. When they are recruited,
pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

rules.name: Shepherd the Afflicted
rules.description: Add 1 to the maximum distance other friendly fighters can move if they started the move within 6" of this fighter.

rules.name: Demonic Conduit
rules.description: Once per battle, when a friendly Demon fighter would be set up from reserve, they can instead be set up within 3" of this fighter, not engaged in melee with any enemy fighters.

rules.name: Rite of Contagion
rules.description:
Once per battle, if this fighter is not engaged, this fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Rite of Contagion [Bonus Action]**: Each enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter must pass a Willpower test else suffer 1 point of damage and be *poisoned* (See the *Poison* weapon trait).

rules.name: Last Rites
rules.description: Each time another fighter is taken down within 6" of this fighter, this fighter can heal 1 life point.

rules.name: Unholy Sermon
rules.description:
Once per battle, if this fighter is not engaged, this fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Unholy Sermon [Bonus Action]**: Until the end of the round, add 1 to Attack rolls for melee attacks made by friendly fighters while they are within 6" of this fighter.

rules.name: The Black Benediction
rules.description: Subtract 1 from the Damage and Critical Damage values of weapons while they target this fighter (to a minimum of 1).

rules.name: Infested with Maggots
rules.description: Each time this fighter activates, if it has suffered any damage, roll a dice. On a 4+, they heal 1 life point.

rules.name: Black Blood
rules.description: This fighter cannot be *poisoned*.

rules.name: Toxic Miasma
rules.description: Each time an enemy fighter activates while they are engaged in melee with this fighter, they must pass a Willpower test or suffer 1 point of damage.

rules.name: Shroud of Flies
rules.description: Subtract 1 from attack rolls that target this fighter.

rules.name: Vessel of Black Rot
rules.description: When this fighter is taken down, roll a dice for each enemy fighter within 6". Of a 4+ they become *poisoned* (see *Poison* weapon trait).

rules.name: Vector of Entropy
rules.description: Worsen the Armour value of enemy fighters by 1 (to a minimum of '-') while they are engaged in melee with this fighter.
